title: Freya and the Tide
author: Edmund Thackeray
blurb: Ines Eriksen, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
